---
name: A space, an operation, or a capability
about: Something the library should be able to express and cannot
labels: enhancement
---

## What you want to express

<!--
State it as the thing you would write, not as an implementation. "I want
to put an object on a hyperbolic surface and have collisions work" is a
better issue than "add a Hyperbolic collider" -- the first says what has
to be true, and the answer may already exist under another name.
-->

## What you tried

<!--
Which concept or type you reached for and where it stopped. This is often
the whole issue: the library is concept-driven, so the useful question is
usually "which concept is this missing" rather than "which class".
-->

## Is it already on the map?

<!--
`docs/ROADMAP.md`'s Backlog is long and honest, including about what is
*not* going to happen and why. If your idea is in there, saying so and
disagreeing with the reasoning is a completely fine issue -- several
entries changed after being argued with.
-->
